coordinateNotes.u_v: normalized position on the FULL equirectangular image: u 0→1 left→right (0.5 = image centre = yaw 0); v 0.68 on the floor line
coordinateNotes.plan: x/y in the pixel space of plan/floorplan.webp = the plan crop (3750×3900 px, ≈2.268 px/cm, rotated as the architect drew it) × 0.4
coordinateNotes.hotspots: u from the plan bearing to the opening the visitor walks through (cameras.json `via`), minus the bearing the panorama centre faces (`lookAt`); computed by tools/make-scenes.mjs, not calibrated by eye
coordinateNotes.heading: the start yaw of every room is 0, the panorama centre the prompt aimed (cameras.json lookAt; centreBearingDeg is that bearing in plan image space)
